history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) and the United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) develop workplan templates that include benchmarks, success criteria and performance indicators, and improve the method to more effectively measure non-quantifiable deliverables.
history.administration_response: UNAMA has developed a workplan template to measure non-quantified deliverables. UNSOM has developed a template for 2021 workplans for substantive sections, considering the auditors’ recommendations. The template included concrete targets and outputs linked to the Mission’s strategic guidance provided through mandates, results-based budgets and existing United Nations-wide frameworks such as the mutual accountability framework and the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework for Somalia. Elements for performance monitoring and reporting were also included to facilitate follow-up and performance measurement.
history.board_assessment: Given that the UNSOM workplan for 2022 has been developed, the Board considered this recommendation implemented.
